headline: Takagi Seiko Corporation Hit by Ransomware Attack, Data Compromised
body: Takagi Seiko Corporation, a prominent automotive components supplier, has disclosed a ransomware attack that resulted in the theft of personal and sensitive internal data. The breach, which occurred months ago, was only recently discovered. Despite the intrusion, Takagi Seiko Corporation's operations continued without interruption. The company has notified affected individuals and has engaged incident responders to address the situation. Further details are expected as the investigation progresses.
